ai_opportunities.name: AI Voice Receptionist & Call Handling
ai_opportunities.description: AI phone system that answers calls 24/7, books appointments, answers FAQs, and handles after-hours inquiries

value_saved.description: Reduces front desk phone burden, handles after-hours calls

value_created.description: Capture calls that would go to voicemail, book appointments 24/7

connect_and_automate.approach: Build AI voice receptionist with Claude Code using Twilio MCP for call handling and Google Calendar MCP for appointment scheduling. Configure call routing, FAQ responses, and after-hours booking logic.

enhance_with_ai.approach: Deploy Weave Phones, RevenueWell Phone with advanced AI capabilities for autonomous handling

targeted_upgrade.when_needed: When building custom isn't practical or you want a managed solution with vendor support

roi_example.scenario: Dental practice missing 25% of calls, getting 20 after-hours calls/week
roi_example.value_created: Capture additional appointments from missed/after-hours calls
roi_example.assumptions: Not all captured calls convert to appointments; assumes €200-250 avg appointment value

jevons_effect.mechanism: 24/7 booking + no missed calls → capture more patients → may need more hygienists/providers

ai_opportunities.yc_reference: Similar to Barti (eye care) which raised $12M Series A for AI receptionist + operating system
ai_opportunities.recommendation_rationale: An AI voice receptionist can be built by connecting your existing phone and scheduling tools with Claude Code and Twilio MCP. This gives you full control over call routing, brand voice, and booking logic at a fraction of managed service costs.

ai_opportunities.name: Automated Patient Communication System
ai_opportunities.description: Two-way texting, automated reminders, and personalized recall campaigns

value_saved.description: Eliminates manual reminder calls and follow-up tasks

value_created.description: Reduce no-shows by 50%, improve recall compliance

connect_and_automate.approach: Build automated reminder and recall system with Claude Code using Twilio MCP for SMS/email and Supabase for patient data. Set up scheduled reminder workflows and two-way text response handling.

enhance_with_ai.approach: Deploy Weave Complete, RevenueWell with advanced AI capabilities for autonomous handling

targeted_upgrade.when_needed: When you want a turnkey HIPAA-compliant communication platform without development overhead

roi_example.value_created: Reduce no-shows through automated reminders and confirmations
roi_example.assumptions: No-show reduction varies by patient demographics; some slots may not be refillable

ai_opportunities.recommendation_rationale: Patient communication requires HIPAA-compliant two-way messaging, automated recall campaigns, and practice management integration. Dental-specific platforms like Weave and RevenueWell provide this out of the box with compliance built in — building custom HIPAA-compliant messaging from scratch adds significant development and compliance burden for a practice without engineering staff.

ai_opportunities.name: AI-Powered Insurance Verification
ai_opportunities.description: Real-time eligibility checks and automated benefits breakdown

value_saved.description: Eliminate manual phone calls to insurance companies

value_created.description: Fewer claim denials, faster payment, better patient experience

connect_and_automate.approach: RPA bot + AI for insurance verification across multiple portals

enhance_with_ai.approach: Deploy Dental Intelligence, Jarvis Analytics with advanced AI capabilities for autonomous handling

targeted_upgrade.when_needed: When you want integrated verification with your practice management system and broad payer coverage

roi_example.scenario: Practice verifying 50 patients/week manually (30 min each)
roi_example.value_created: Reduce manual verification time and improve claim accuracy
roi_example.assumptions: Savings depend on current manual process efficiency; not all verifications automate equally

ai_opportunities.recommendation_rationale: Insurance verification can be automated with an RPA bot connecting to payer portals, extracting eligibility data, and feeding it into your practice management system. This approach works across all payers and avoids per-verification fees.

ai_opportunities.name: 24/7 Online Patient Scheduling
ai_opportunities.description: Allow patients to self-schedule appointments online anytime

value_created.description: Capture appointments outside office hours, reduce phone traffic

connect_and_automate.approach: Build custom booking widget with Claude Code as a React component. Connect to Google Calendar MCP for availability and Supabase for patient records. Embed on practice website with custom scheduling rules.

enhance_with_ai.approach: Deploy NexHealth Pro, Dental Intelligence scheduling with advanced AI capabilities for autonomous handling

targeted_upgrade.when_needed: When you want a managed scheduling solution with patient-facing marketplace and easy setup

roi_example.value_created: Reduce phone scheduling burden and capture after-hours bookings
roi_example.assumptions: Online booking adoption varies; some patients prefer phone; requires staff training

ai_opportunities.recommendation_rationale: A custom booking widget connected to your calendar and patient records gives you full control over scheduling rules, branding, and the patient experience — without monthly platform fees.

ai_opportunities.name: AI-Assisted Treatment Planning & Imaging
ai_opportunities.description: AI analysis of X-rays and scans to assist with diagnosis and treatment planning

value_saved.description: Faster image analysis, reduced second opinions

value_created.description: Catch more issues, improve case acceptance with visuals

connect_and_automate.approach: Not recommended - FDA approval requirements make custom AI infeasible

enhance_with_ai.approach: Deploy Pearl Second Opinion + Practice Analytics with advanced AI capabilities for autonomous handling

targeted_upgrade.when_needed: FDA-cleared AI imaging is the recommended path — custom diagnostic AI requires regulatory approval that individual practices cannot obtain

roi_example.value_created: Improve case acceptance through better visual communication
roi_example.assumptions: Case acceptance improvement varies; requires consistent use by all providers; results take time

ai_opportunities.recommendation_rationale: FDA-cleared AI imaging tools like Pearl and Overjet are the only viable path for diagnostic AI in dental practices. Custom-built solutions cannot obtain FDA clearance, and the liability risk of uncleared diagnostic tools is unacceptable. These purpose-built tools integrate directly with your imaging software and provide immediate clinical value.

ai_opportunities.name: In-House Patient Financing Automation
ai_opportunities.description: Offer payment plans and financing options to increase treatment acceptance

value_saved.description: Automated payment plan setup and collection

value_created.description: More patients say yes to treatment when payment options available
value_created.potential_revenue_impact: 20-40% increase in case acceptance for larger cases

connect_and_automate.approach: Build payment plan management system with Claude Code using Stripe MCP for recurring payments and Supabase for plan tracking. Create patient-facing payment portal and automated reminder workflows.

enhance_with_ai.approach: Deploy Sunbit + in-house payment plans via Weave with advanced AI capabilities for autonomous handling
tools_used: Sunbit + in-house payment plans via Weave

targeted_upgrade.when_needed: Patient financing requires credit underwriting and regulatory compliance — dedicated platforms handle this natively with zero upfront cost

roi_example.scenario: 10 patients/month declining €2,000+ treatment due to cost
roi_example.value_created: Convert cost-declined patients through financing options
roi_example.assumptions: Conversion varies by patient demographics; transaction fees reduce margin; some patients may default

ai_opportunities.recommendation_rationale: Patient financing requires credit underwriting, compliance with lending regulations, and chargeback protection — capabilities that cannot be built in-house. Dedicated platforms like CareCredit and Sunbit handle instant credit decisions, regulatory compliance, and collections, with zero upfront cost to the practice.

ai_opportunities.name: Automated Reputation & Review Management
ai_opportunities.description: Systematically generate reviews and manage online reputation

value_saved.description: Automated review requests, no manual follow-up

value_created.description: Higher Google ranking, more new patient calls

connect_and_automate.approach: Build automated review request system with Claude Code using Twilio MCP for SMS/email triggers after appointments. Include personalized messaging, Google review link generation, and a simple dashboard for tracking review volume.

enhance_with_ai.approach: Deploy Birdeye + Google integration with advanced AI capabilities for autonomous handling

targeted_upgrade.when_needed: When you want a managed solution with multi-platform review monitoring and response templates

roi_example.value_created: Improve online reputation and visibility through consistent review generation
roi_example.assumptions: Attribution from reviews to new patients is indirect; results compound over time; competitive market affects impact

ai_opportunities.recommendation_rationale: Automated review requests can be built with Twilio MCP for SMS/email triggers after appointments. Low ongoing cost and customized messaging, though you won't get the advanced reputation dashboard that dedicated platforms offer.

ai_opportunities.name: AI-Powered Patient Acquisition
ai_opportunities.description: Optimize Google Ads, landing pages, and lead scoring to attract and convert new patients cost-effectively

value_saved.description: Automates ad campaign management, lead follow-up, and conversion tracking

value_created.description: Lower cost-per-acquisition, higher quality leads, better ad ROI
value_created.potential_revenue_impact: 20-40% reduction in cost per new patient

connect_and_automate.approach: Build AI-powered ad optimization with Claude Code connecting Google Ads API, landing page builder, and CRM. Auto-adjust bids based on conversion data, generate ad copy variations, and score incoming leads.
cons: Requires Google Ads expertise to set up

enhance_with_ai.approach: Deploy AI marketing platform that manages campaigns end-to-end with machine learning optimization

targeted_upgrade.when_needed: When you want a dental-specific marketing agency that handles everything

roi_example.scenario: Practice spending €2,000/month on Google Ads with €150 cost per new patient
roi_example.value_created: Reduce cost-per-acquisition and increase conversion rate
roi_example.assumptions: Results depend on current ad efficiency, market competition, and landing page quality

ai_opportunities.recommendation_rationale: Google Ads API and analytics data are accessible. A Claude workflow optimizing bids, generating ad variations, and scoring leads gives you agency-level optimization without agency-level fees.

ai_opportunities.name: Automated Insurance Claims Processing
ai_opportunities.description: Reduce claim rejections and speed up reimbursement with AI-powered claims submission, error detection, and follow-up automation

value_saved.description: Eliminates manual claim submission, error correction, and follow-up calls

value_created.description: Fewer claim denials, faster reimbursement cycles, improved cash flow

connect_and_automate.approach: Build AI claims processor with Claude Code that validates claims before submission, detects common rejection patterns, auto-corrects errors, and tracks reimbursement status

enhance_with_ai.approach: Deploy AI claims management platform with predictive denial prevention and automated appeal generation

targeted_upgrade.when_needed: When claims volume is high and you want a fully managed clearinghouse with AI enhancement
cons: Limited AI capabilities in basic tiers

roi_example.scenario: Practice submitting 500 claims/month with 12% rejection rate
roi_example.value_created: Reduce rejections and speed up reimbursement cycle
roi_example.assumptions: Average claim value €200-400; rejection handling costs €25-50 per claim in staff time

ai_opportunities.recommendation_rationale: Claims processing follows patterns that AI excels at detecting. A Claude workflow analyzing your historical rejections and pre-validating claims before submission can dramatically reduce your rejection rate.

ai_opportunities.name: AI Dental Imaging Analysis
ai_opportunities.description: AI-assisted cavity detection, periodontal assessment, and treatment planning from X-rays and CBCT scans

value_saved.description: Faster image analysis, fewer missed findings, reduced second opinions

value_created.description: Improved diagnostic accuracy, higher case acceptance through visual AI overlays
value_created.potential_revenue_impact: 10-20% increase in treatment acceptance when patients see AI-annotated images

connect_and_automate.approach: Not feasible — dental diagnostic AI requires FDA/CE clearance that cannot be obtained by individual practices

enhance_with_ai.approach: Deploy FDA-cleared AI imaging platform that integrates with your existing digital X-ray system for real-time analysis

targeted_upgrade.when_needed: FDA-cleared AI dental imaging is the only viable path — this is a 'buy, don't build' category

roi_example.scenario: Practice with €60K/month production, 42% treatment acceptance rate
roi_example.value_created: Improve case acceptance through AI-annotated imaging and better diagnostic support
roi_example.assumptions: Acceptance improvement varies by practice; requires consistent provider adoption; AI is a second read, not a replacement for clinical judgment

ai_opportunities.recommendation_rationale: Dental imaging AI must be FDA/CE-cleared — this is a regulatory requirement, not a preference. Pearl and Overjet are the leaders with published clinical accuracy data. Building custom diagnostic AI is not an option for dental practices.

ai_opportunities.description: AI-driven demand forecasting and staff scheduling that maximizes chair utilization and minimizes overtime

value_saved.description: Eliminates manual schedule juggling and reduces overstaffing

value_created.description: Higher chair utilization, reduced overtime costs, better patient flow

connect_and_automate.approach: Build demand forecasting model with Claude Code using historical appointment data to predict busy periods, optimize staff schedules, and flag gaps or overlaps

enhance_with_ai.approach: Deploy AI scheduling platform with real-time optimization, demand prediction, and automated staff notifications

targeted_upgrade.when_needed: When your practice has multiple locations or complex multi-provider scheduling needs

roi_example.value_created: Optimize staff scheduling to increase chair utilization
roi_example.assumptions: Each 1% utilization improvement ≈ €500-800/month additional production; requires staff buy-in for schedule changes

ai_opportunities.recommendation_rationale: Your PMS already has all the appointment and scheduling data. A Claude workflow analyzing patterns and predicting demand gives you 80% of the value of premium analytics tools at a fraction of the cost.

ai_opportunities.name: Patient Communication Hub
ai_opportunities.description: Unified multi-channel patient communication (SMS, email, portal) with AI-drafted responses and automated follow-ups

value_saved.description: Consolidates all patient communication into one platform with AI assistance

value_created.description: Faster response times, consistent messaging, better patient experience
value_created.potential_revenue_impact: 15-20% improvement in patient retention through better engagement

connect_and_automate.approach: Build unified communication hub with Claude Code connecting SMS (Twilio), email, and patient portal. AI drafts responses to common inquiries, routes complex questions to staff, and automates follow-up sequences.

enhance_with_ai.approach: Deploy dental communication platform with AI-powered messaging, two-way texting, and automated campaigns

targeted_upgrade.when_needed: When HIPAA compliance burden of custom-built solution outweighs the cost savings

roi_example.scenario: Practice handling 200+ patient messages/week across phone, email, and portal
roi_example.value_created: Consolidate communication channels and automate routine responses
roi_example.assumptions: Routine inquiries (scheduling, billing, insurance) make up 60-70% of patient messages

ai_opportunities.recommendation_rationale: Patient communication in dental requires HIPAA-compliant two-way messaging, VoIP integration, and dental-specific templates. Platforms like Weave provide this natively — building custom HIPAA-compliant messaging adds significant compliance burden that most practices shouldn't take on.

not_recommended.name: Custom practice management software
not_recommended.reason: Dental PM systems are complex and heavily regulated; existing solutions are mature
not_recommended.alternative: Use established PM (Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Open Dental) and add integrations

not_recommended.name: Custom AI diagnostic imaging
not_recommended.reason: FDA approval requirements make custom medical AI extremely expensive and risky
not_recommended.alternative: Use FDA-cleared solutions like Pearl or Overjet

not_recommended.name: Building your own patient portal
not_recommended.reason: HIPAA compliance complexity; patients expect standardized experiences
not_recommended.alternative: Use portal from communication platform (Weave, NexHealth)

anti_patterns.name: Building Custom Diagnostic AI
anti_patterns.why_avoid: FDA/CE clearance requirements make custom medical AI prohibitively expensive and legally risky for practices
anti_patterns.what_instead: Use FDA-cleared solutions like Pearl or Overjet that have published clinical accuracy data

anti_patterns.name: Deploying All-in-One Platform Before Fixing Basics
anti_patterns.why_avoid: Practices often buy comprehensive platforms (Weave, RevenueWell) before they've fixed basic scheduling and recall processes — the platform amplifies existing chaos
anti_patterns.what_instead: Fix core workflows first (reminders, recall, insurance verification), then layer on comprehensive platforms

anti_patterns.name: Building Custom HIPAA-Compliant Messaging
anti_patterns.why_avoid: HIPAA compliance for patient messaging requires BAA agreements, encryption, audit trails, and breach notification procedures that are expensive to build and maintain
anti_patterns.what_instead: Use dental-specific communication platforms that include HIPAA compliance out of the box
